brief:
Israeli occupation forces violated the Gaza ceasefire on Friday through continuous bombardment and gunfire operations, Shehab Wire reported. A local source said that Fadi al-Abadla, a young man, was killed by Israeli forces' fire in the town of al-Qarr during the incidents.

The shooting marked another reported breach of the ceasefire agreement that had been in effect in the enclave. Israeli forces have faced repeated accusations of violating the terms through military operations across Gaza.
